requires a signed release

observations.why: The text frames a mandatory gate as a security and process-integrity measure — conservation of stability plus competence of craft.

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Citing past failures as justification for a protective gate appeals to conservation — preventing recurrence to keep what works stable.
The gate label restates a mandatory integrity check — conservation of deployment security and competence of verified craft.
Extending the gate's scope across all environments appeals to conservation — uniform security coverage to maintain stability.
Naming an owner assigns self-origination and accountability — the autonomy of the individual who holds the gate.
